thread:
leo: Quick kickoff 15m async sprint. Need final micro-variants for landing heroes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), one concise benchmark teaser for social (no raw numbers), and a crisp webinar-to-lead routing map. Aim: copy live in the launch doc by EOD tomorrow.

anya: Tone map: Hosted = energetic PLG; Dedicated = operational, cost-focused; Private = compliance-trust. Keep heroes 5-7 words max, subheads one short sentence, CTAs 1-3 words.

sam: Draft heroes + subheads + CTAs (compact)
- Hosted: "Start with Redwood Hosted"  "Launch prototypes fast, scale confidently."  "Try Hosted"
- Dedicated: "Dedicated GPU capacity"  "Predictable throughput for steady production."  "Reserve capacity"
- Private: "Private deployments & installs"  "VPC, KMS, and on-prem for regulated apps."  "Contact sales"

copybot: Alternate phrasing (micro A/B)
- Hosted alt: "Hosted API for builders"  "Spin up models in minutes."  "Start free"
- Dedicated alt: "Reserved pools for production"  "SLA-backed latency and cost optimization."  "Get capacity"
- Private alt: "Run Redwood in your network"  "Keep data in your control."  "Request demo"

leo: For social benchmark teaser we need safe language. Proposed: "Join our live webinar for an independent demo and a benchmark walkthrough comparing Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments." Short alt for X: "Demo + benchmarks  5/14  Register now."

anya: Webinar format: 30m demo, 15m benchmark walkthrough, 15m live Q&A. Reg page should ask deployment interest (hosted / dedicated / private) as a required field so we can route.

ops: HubSpot routing pseudo (for ops to convert):
```
# field: deployment_interest -> hosted | dedicated | private
if deployment_interest == "hosted":
  lifecycle_stage = "MQL"
  owner = "marketing"
  add_hidden utm_campaign = "launch_webinar"
if deployment_interest == "dedicated":
  owner = "AE_pool"
  tag = "dedicated_inquiry"
  notify = "ae-team@redwood.com"
if deployment_interest == "private":
  owner = "Enterprise_SDR"
  priority = "high"
  notify = "sales-enterprise@redwood.com"
```
Also recommend hidden fields: utm_source=social, utm_medium=social_post.

sam: Reg confirmation microcopy: "Thanks for registering  calendar invite sent. If you selected Dedicated or Private, an AE will reach out after the event. Reply to this email if you need immediate contact." Also add secondary CTA on the thank-you page: "Talk to AE" for Dedicated/Private leads.

leo: Tasks: Sam  drop final chosen hero per mode into the launch doc and flag primaries. Anya  pick the social teaser and prep LinkedIn + X copy. Ops  convert the pseudo to HubSpot workflow and paste workflow IDs here when live. I'll QA copy and send to design. Thanks team :rocket:
